text:
jules: quick check — onboarding Argus9b weights. where are the S3 paths? seeing weird tokenization diffs vs local qna tests
morgan: @jules weights in s3://redwood-models/argus9b/v1/weights.tar.gz
jules: got them. tokenizer mismatch: inference outputs have extra space before commas compared to hf tokenizer.
anika: Argus's tokenizer got a custom pre-tokenize rule during qlora conversion; it normalizes punctuation adding leading spaces for some clusters. intended for sequence modeling, not chat.
yuri: infra: do runtime nodes use model metadata tokenizer_override or fallback to repo default?
infra-bot: deploy-check: model metadata present for argus9b/v1. tokenizer_override: true. config checksum OK.
morgan: could patch runtime postprocess to strip leading-space before punctuation in chat mode, less risky than changing model artifacts.
jules: perf FYI — microbench on p4d (8x) bs=8 shows tail spikes.
```
./perf_run --model argus9b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --iters 200
median 1.1s/token
p99 2.8s/token (occasional ~4.1s)
```
anika: did you try kv-cache prewarm? argus kernel selector might be switching kernels on the fly under certain seq dist.
jules: re-run with kv-prewarm and aten_fast_math=false. p99 improved to ~1.6s, median 0.85s. I'll upload profiles to /tmp/argus_profs/
morgan: plan: merge tokenizer postprocess PR then canary on dedicated pool, run 1k-smoke perf. fallback route: argus9b-compact if latency >2s
anika: PR LGTM, added unit test for "Hello , world" -> "Hello, world"
jules: PR merged (#4827). scheduling canary tomorrow 09:30 PT and will post perf logs here :rocket:
